judged_text: `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&` between isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner — a conjunction that can never authorize a team admin (a membership holds a single role, so under any role semantics the AND excludes admins), contradicting the 'AdminOrOwner' name that signals `||`. Team admins (and under strict ADMIN-only/OWNER-only helpers, owners too) who are not the organizer or an existing attendee receive FORBIDDEN 'you_do_not_have_permission' when adding guests to their team's bookings, making the team-management path of this feature unreachable for exactly the users it names.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. This requires the user to be both an admin and an owner to pass, which contradicts the variable name and intended authorization semantics (“AdminOrOwner” implies `||`). The subsequent guard `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN` means a team admin (who is not also the organizer or an existing attendee) will be denied access to add guests, making the team-admin management path effectively unreachable for admins per the code shown.
